texts.text: The Foundation for Modern Cyber Defense

texts.label: text
texts.orig: The CIS Critical Security Controls® (CIS Controls®) is the foundation organizations need to defend against today's most common and impactful cyber threats.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: SEC566: Implementing and Auditing CIS Controls
texts.text: SEC566: Implementing and Auditing CIS Controls

texts.label: text
texts.orig: SEC566 equips security leaders and practitioners to apply and audit the CIS Critical Security Controls (v8.1) across enterprise, cloud, third-party, and AI-driven environments. Through hands-on labs, Cyber42 leadership simulations, and new AI-focused modules, students gain the expertise to design, validate, and continuously improve cybersecurity programs that withstand today's threats and tomorrow's regulatory scrutiny. To deepen your expertise in securing AI technologies, explore the SANS Critical AI Security Guidelines, a companion resource designed to help organizations build trustworthy, secure AI operations. sans.org/sec566
